design_overview: QuickStock is a mobile-first PWA built for speed: scan, confirm and save in 3 taps. Clean cards, color-coded stock states, a persistent live-sync indicator and a bottom navigation bar for clerks, managers and owners.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: Give managers and clerks a live overview of stock health, low-stock items and recent changes.

key_components.name: Dashboard Header
key_components.styling: Deep blue gradient header with title 'QuickStock', store name 'Main Street Store' and white bell icon with red count badge.
key_components.interaction: Tapping bell opens Alerts screen.

key_components.name: Live Sync Chip
key_components.styling: Rounded green pill with pulsing dot, text 'Live · synced 1s ago'.
key_components.interaction: Tap shows connected devices tooltip.

key_components.name: Stat Cards Row
key_components.styling: Three white rounded cards: 'Total SKUs 1,248', 'Stock Value $48.2k', 'Low Stock 12' in warning color.
key_components.interaction: Tapping a card opens Stock screen filtered accordingly.

key_components.name: Low Stock Card
key_components.styling: White card with amber left border, title 'Needs Reordering', three items with remaining quantity and suggested reorder amounts.
key_components.interaction: Tap card or 'View all' opens Low-Stock Alerts screen.

key_components.name: Recent Activity List
key_components.styling: Rows with product thumbnail, 'Oat Milk 1L −3', user name and time; green or red quantity text.
key_components.interaction: Tap row opens Product Detail screen.

key_components.name: Quick Scan Button
key_components.styling: Floating primary blue pill button 'Scan Item' with soft shadow above the nav bar.
key_components.interaction: Opens Scan screen with camera active.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation
key_components.styling: White bar with five tabs; active tab 'Home' in blue with label, others grey.
key_components.interaction: Switches between Home, Scan, Stock, Alerts and Reports.

screens.user_flow: Lands here after login. Leaves via Scan button, alert card, activity row or bottom navigation.

screens.name: Scan Barcode
screens.purpose: Scan a barcode with camera or handheld scanner to find a product or register an unknown one.

key_components.name: Scan Header
key_components.styling: Transparent dark bar over camera with title 'Scan Barcode' and white back arrow.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to Dashboard.

key_components.name: Camera Viewfinder
key_components.styling: Full-width live camera feed with dim overlay and rounded teal corner frame, hint 'Align barcode within frame'.
key_components.interaction: Auto-detects barcode and opens result sheet within 1 second.

key_components.name: Handheld Scanner Toggle
key_components.styling: Pill switch labeled 'Handheld scanner' with teal active state.
key_components.interaction: Enables hardware scanner input and pauses camera.

key_components.name: Manual Barcode Input
key_components.styling: White rounded input with placeholder 'Type barcode number' and trailing 'Find' button.
key_components.interaction: Submits code and opens Product Found sheet.

key_components.name: Product Found Sheet
key_components.styling: Bottom sheet with product photo, 'Oat Milk 1L', 'In stock: 24', green badge and primary button 'Update Stock'.
key_components.interaction: Update Stock opens Product Detail screen.

key_components.name: Unknown Barcode Dialog
key_components.styling: Rounded dialog: 'New barcode detected', code shown, primary 'Create Product', secondary 'Scan Again'.
key_components.interaction: Create Product opens New Product form with barcode prefilled.

key_components.name: New Product Form
key_components.styling: Full-height sheet with inputs 'Product name', 'Category', 'Price', 'Starting quantity', primary 'Save Product'.
key_components.interaction: Save adds product and opens its Product Detail screen.

key_components.name: Recent Scans List
key_components.styling: Horizontal chips with thumbnails of the last five scanned items.
key_components.interaction: Tap chip reopens that product's Product Found sheet.

screens.user_flow: Reached via Scan tab or Dashboard button. Leaves to Product Detail, New Product form or back to Dashboard.

screens.name: Product Detail & Stock Update
screens.purpose: View live stock for one product, adjust quantity, set reorder threshold and see its change history.

key_components.name: Detail Header
key_components.styling: White bar with back arrow, title 'Oat Milk 1L' and edit icon.
key_components.interaction: Back returns to previous screen; edit opens product info form.

key_components.name: Product Hero Card
key_components.styling: Rounded card with product photo, SKU, barcode and green 'Live' sync badge.
key_components.interaction: Tap photo to replace image.

key_components.name: Current Stock Display
key_components.styling: Large 28px number '24 units' with status pill 'In Stock' in green, switching amber or red when low.
key_components.interaction: Updates instantly when another device changes stock.

key_components.name: Quantity Stepper
key_components.styling: Big touch-friendly minus and plus buttons around numeric input, placeholder '0'.
key_components.interaction: Adjusts the pending change amount before saving.

key_components.name: Reason Chips
key_components.styling: Selectable pills: 'Sale', 'Receipt', 'Adjustment', 'Damaged'; selected is filled blue.
key_components.interaction: Sets reason recorded in audit history.

key_components.name: Save Stock Button
key_components.styling: Full-width blue gradient button 'Save Stock Update' with soft shadow.
key_components.interaction: Saves change, syncs devices and shows success toast.

key_components.name: Reorder Threshold Input
key_components.styling: Card with input placeholder 'Alert below (units)' and suggested reorder quantity field.
key_components.interaction: Saves threshold used to generate low-stock alerts.

key_components.name: Item History List
key_components.styling: Compact rows: '−3 Sale', user 'Maria K.', time '10:42 AM'; green or red quantities.
key_components.interaction: 'View full history' opens Reports audit tab.

screens.user_flow: Opened from Scan result, Stock list, Dashboard activity or Alerts. Saving returns to previous screen with toast.

screens.name: Stock List
screens.purpose: Browse and search all products with live quantities to avoid selling out-of-stock items.

key_components.name: Stock Header
key_components.styling: White header with title 'Stock' and live sync dot.
key_components.interaction: Tap dot to see last sync time.

key_components.name: Search Input
key_components.styling: Rounded grey input with search icon, placeholder 'Search name, SKU or barcode'.
key_components.interaction: Filters list as the user types.

key_components.name: Filter Button
key_components.styling: Square outlined button beside search with filter icon and active-count badge.
key_components.interaction: Opens filter sheet for category and stock status.

key_components.name: Status Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Scrollable pills: 'All', 'In Stock', 'Low', 'Out of Stock'; active is filled blue.
key_components.interaction: Filters list by stock status.

key_components.name: Product List
key_components.styling: Cards with thumbnail, name, SKU, price and right-aligned quantity badge in green, amber or red.
key_components.interaction: Tap row opens Product Detail screen.

key_components.name: Live Update Highlight
key_components.styling: Row briefly flashes teal when quantity changes remotely, with text 'Updated just now'.
key_components.interaction: Tap scrolls to updated item.

key_components.name: Add Product Button
key_components.styling: Floating blue circular button with white plus icon above navigation.
key_components.interaction: Opens Scan screen to register a new product.

key_components.name: Out of Stock Empty State
key_components.styling: Shown when no match: message 'No products found' with button 'Clear filters'.
key_components.interaction: Clear filters resets search and chips.

screens.user_flow: Reached via Stock tab or Dashboard stat cards. Leaves to Product Detail or Scan.

screens.name: Low-Stock Alerts
screens.purpose: Show items below threshold with suggested reorder quantities and let managers configure alert rules.

key_components.name: Alerts Header
key_components.styling: White header with title 'Alerts' and settings icon at right.
key_components.interaction: Settings icon opens notification settings card.

key_components.name: Alert Summary Banner
key_components.styling: Amber-tinted rounded banner: '12 items below threshold', subtext 'Updated within the last minute'.
key_components.interaction: Tap scrolls to first alert.

key_components.name: Severity Filter Chips
key_components.styling: Pills 'All', 'Out of stock', 'Low'; red or amber dots mark severity.
key_components.interaction: Filters alert cards by severity.

key_components.name: Alert Card
key_components.styling: Card with thumbnail, 'Oat Milk 1L', 'Stock 3 / Threshold 10', suggested 'Reorder 40 units' in bold blue.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens Product Detail screen.

key_components.name: Reorder Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button 'Reorder 40' inside each alert card.
key_components.interaction: Adds item to reorder list and shows confirmation toast.

key_components.name: Share Reorder List Button
key_components.styling: Full-width outlined button 'Share Reorder List with Supplier'.
key_components.interaction: Opens share sheet with reorder list.

key_components.name: Notification Settings Card
key_components.styling: Card with toggle 'Push low-stock alerts' and input placeholder 'Default threshold (units)'.
key_components.interaction: Toggle and save update alert preferences.

key_components.name: Dismiss Alert Action
key_components.styling: Subtle text button 'Snooze 24h' beside each reorder button.
key_components.interaction: Hides alert for 24 hours.

screens.user_flow: Reached via bell icon, Alerts tab or Dashboard card. Leaves to Product Detail or share sheet.

screens.name: Reports & Audit History
screens.purpose: Generate stock and sales reports by date range, export CSV and review every inventory change by user.

key_components.name: Reports Header
key_components.styling: White header with title 'Reports' and share icon for export.
key_components.interaction: Share icon exports current report as CSV.

key_components.name: Report Tabs
key_components.styling: Segmented control: 'Stock', 'Sales', 'Audit History'; active segment filled blue.
key_components.interaction: Switches the report content below.

key_components.name: Date Range Input
key_components.styling: Two rounded date inputs, placeholders 'Start date' and 'End date', with filter button.
key_components.interaction: Sets range used when generating report.

key_components.name: Generate Report Button
key_components.styling: Primary blue button 'Generate Report' with loading spinner.
key_components.interaction: Builds report in under 5 seconds and shows results.

key_components.name: Summary Cards
key_components.styling: Two cards: 'Inventory Value $48.2k' and 'Turnover 4.1x' with small green trend text.
key_components.interaction: Tap opens detailed breakdown list.

key_components.name: Trend Chart
key_components.styling: Rounded card with blue line chart of stock value over selected dates and light grid.
key_components.interaction: Tap point shows value tooltip.

key_components.name: User Filter Dropdown
key_components.styling: Dropdown with placeholder 'All users' for filtering audit rows by staff member.
key_components.interaction: Filters audit list by selected user.

key_components.name: Audit History List
key_components.styling: Rows with item, '−3 units', user 'Maria K.', reason, timestamp; red or green quantity change.
key_components.interaction: Tap row opens Product Detail screen.

key_components.name: Export CSV Button
key_components.styling: Full-width outlined teal button 'Export CSV'.
key_components.interaction: Downloads report as CSV and shows success toast.

screens.user_flow: Reached via Reports tab. Leaves to Product Detail from audit rows or other tabs.

ui_components.name: Primary Button
ui_components.styling: 48px tall, 12px radius, blue gradient, white semibold label, soft shadow.
ui_components.interaction: Press scales slightly; shows spinner while saving.

ui_components.name: Secondary Button
ui_components.styling: White fill, 1px blue border, blue label, 12px radius.

ui_components.name: Text Input
ui_components.styling: 48px height, 12px radius, light grey fill, 1px border, blue focus ring, clear placeholder.
ui_components.interaction: Focus highlights border and opens keyboard.

ui_components.name: Stock Badge
ui_components.styling: Rounded pill with quantity; green in stock, amber low, red out of stock.

ui_components.name: Product Card
ui_components.styling: White card, 16px radius, subtle shadow, thumbnail left, text center, badge right.

ui_components.name: Bottom Sheet
ui_components.styling: White sheet with 24px top radius, drag handle, dimmed backdrop.
ui_components.interaction: Swipe down or tap backdrop to dismiss.

ui_components.name: Toast
ui_components.styling: Dark rounded snackbar with success or error color accent and short message.

ui_components.name: Filter Chip
ui_components.styling: 36px pill, grey outline; selected state filled blue with white text.

ui_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
ui_components.styling: 64px white bar with top border, five icon-label tabs, blue active state.

ui_components.name: Live Sync Indicator
ui_components.styling: Green dot pill with text 'Live'; turns amber 'Reconnecting' when offline.

responsive_design: Mobile-first PWA at 360px with bottom navigation. Tablet uses two-column list and detail; desktop uses a left sidebar with wider tables and charts.
accessibility: WCAG AA contrast, 48px touch targets, text labels beside color-coded stock states, screen-reader labels on icons, visible focus rings, scalable text, and haptic plus visual scan confirmation.
animations: 150ms press feedback, 250ms sheet slide-ups, teal flash on live quantity changes, scan frame pulse, subtle toast fade, and skeleton loaders for reports.
icons: Outline icon set limited to home, search, user, settings, bell, bookmark, heart, filter, plus, edit, trash and share. Search marks scanning, bell marks alerts, share marks export; no emojis.
